# Results generated by this release

The manuscript table is shown in the root README. Its supplied values are not
overwritten by code execution. See docs/RESULTS_PROVENANCE.md for the distinction
between that table, archived private runs and new measurements.

Training writes condition-specific result.json and student_final.pth artifacts
under the selected --output-root. Use different directories for different source
versions, hyperparameters or experiment protocols. Do not put pretrained weights,
raw training logs or local machine paths in a source-code commit.
